_comment: Source-of-truth UI strings in English. `npm run localize` translates these into every registry language and writes content-packs/<pack>/locales/<code>.json. {n} style placeholders are substituted at render time and must survive translation — the localizer checks that they do.
pack.demo: Demo content pack. Technical content is drafted from NESIS, NIS IEC 60364 and NBTE unit standards. Clause references await countersignature by the reviewing trainer before any learner is served.
locale.machine: This language was machine-translated from English and has not been reviewed by a trainer. The English wording is the authority.
ask.title: What do you want to know about the work?
ask.sub: Talk the way you talk on site. Every answer comes from a reviewed standard and shows you the clause.
ask.listening: Listening — speak now, then tap to stop
ask.unavailable: Voice input is not available here — tap an example below
ask.retrieved: Retrieved from {n} reviewed passages · 0 KB network · lesson {lesson}
ask.refuse: Nothing in the {trade} pack covers that. I will not answer from outside a reviewed standard — a confident wrong answer about this work can get somebody hurt.
ask.refuseHint: Ask your trainer, or ask me about cable sizing, earthing, protection devices, changeover, or testing.
ask.examplesSub: Tap one to play it through as if it were spoken. Demo-safe path: the live demo never depends on a single unrehearsed utterance.
ask.notified: {trainer}, your trainer, has been notified privately. Nobody else was told.
ask.deleted: Record deleted. Your trainer's copy was withdrawn.
ask.sentNote: This is the exact message sent to your trainer. Nothing else about you was included — no recording, no location, no other questions.
learn.title: Five lessons
learn.sub: Each one is short, downloadable, and ends in a practice task you do by voice or by photo. No reading required.
learn.savedAll: All five lessons saved for offline use.
learn.mustDo: What you must be able to do
learn.conductorNote: Green-and-yellow is reserved for protective conductors. It is a message to the next person who opens the board.
learn.listen: Listen to this lesson in your language
practice.title: Practice
practice.typePlaceholder: Or type what you would say…
practice.noMcqNote: Competency is never assessed by multiple choice. Reading and writing are not required — the typed box exists only because this browser may block the microphone.
practice.addPhoto: Add a photo from your phone
practice.photoNote: Your photo stays on your device until you choose to send it for countersignature.
practice.awaiting: Awaiting trainer countersignature. You can delete this evidence at any time.
recall.title: Do you still remember it?
recall.sub: Three days after a lesson, then ten, then thirty — a voice note arrives on WhatsApp. Answer by pressing one key. No app to open, no data to buy.
recall.clockNote: The clock control exists for the demo only. In the field, time passes by itself.
recall.empty: Finish a lesson practice task and its recall check will be scheduled for three days later.
recall.featurePhone: Works on a feature phone: the question is audio, the answer is one keypress, the whole exchange is under 10 KB.
recall.retained: Retained through all three checks — day 3, 10 and 30
recall.missed: Missed on day {day} — repeating tomorrow, and the lesson is back on your list
recall.correctOn: Correct on day {day} · next check day {next}
recall.outcome: Retained on first attempt: {hits} of {total} checks. A missed check puts the lesson back on the list — that is the measured learning outcome, not a streak counter.
passport.notCert: This is a progress record and NSQF-aligned evidence portfolio, not a certificate. An accredited assessor still signs the qualification. SabiPass is throughput for the existing Recognition of Prior Learning route.
passport.verifyNote: A customer with any phone can confirm this record. Dial the USSD string or read the code out.
passport.qrOffline: QR needs a connection. The code and USSD string above work offline.
passport.portfolioNote: This is the bundle an accredited assessor receives. It collapses their job from running an assessment centre to reviewing and endorsing.
trainer.privacy: You see only what your own apprentices send you, and only what they have not deleted. No institution and no third party receives these.
trainer.noFlags: Nothing flagged. Flags are raised automatically when an apprentice describes unsafe practice — they do not have to ask.
trainer.noQueue: Nothing waiting. Complete a practice task as the learner and it appears here.
settings.textOnlyNote: Turn off spoken output. Text alternatives are always shown either way.
settings.whyBody: Nigeria's National Skills Qualifications Framework already recognises skills learned informally, through Recognition of Prior Learning, launched in 2025. Roughly 500 artisans have been assessed nationwide since then, because assessment is human, in-person and scarce.
settings.whyBody2: SabiPass makes that assessment remote, voice-native and near-free. The framework exists. The throughput does not.
settings.notBuiltBody: Payments, job matching, public course uploads, certificates. A training-centre subscription is a commercial hypothesis to validate, not a feature.
